fusions.name: Cut the Lacings
fusions.desc: A quick chop at the target's straps and lacings for 5 damage, leaving it 5% easier to wound for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Streamered Throw
fusions.desc: Hurls the axe, trailing a cloth streamer, at an enemy up to 6 tiles away that is at or below 25% health for 26 damage, up to 1.3 times as much at full reach. The streamer slows it by 30% for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Grip Wrapping
fusions.desc: Binds the haft tight with cloth, raising your slashing damage by 25% for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Measured for a Shroud
fusions.desc: You deal 12% more damage to enemies below 50% health.
